question: State the set code of the set with release date of 07/13/2007?
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
gold: SELECT T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.releaseDate = '2007-07-13'
gold0: SELECT T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.releaseDate = '2007-07-13'

d.request: What are the set codes for sets released on 07/13/2007, including those with no matching `set_translations` record?
d.sql: SELECT s.code FROM sets AS s LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.releaseDate = '2007-07-13' GROUP BY s.code

c.request:
State the set code of the set with release date of 07/13/2007?
Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
c.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.code FROM sets AS s LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.releaseDate = '2007-07-13';

b.request: Return the code of each set released on July 13, 2007, including sets with no matching set_translations record
b.sql: SELECT s.code FROM sets AS s LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.releaseDate = '2007-07-13' GROUP BY s.code
